Rap,Ⓒv. t.ⒹtIvraM prahf 1 P or taq 10 or aBihan 2 P.
Ⓑ
 2 apa-, hf 1 P; grah 9 U, cittaM-manaH-Akfz 1 P or grah.
Ⓔs.ⒹtIvra-prahAraH-AGAtaH.

Rapacious,Ⓒa.Ⓓati-, lubDaka, apahArin, apaharaRaSIla, grasanabudDi, sarvahArin-grAhin, sAhasika (kI f.).
Ⓝ[Rapacious]ly,Ⓒadv.Ⓓprasahya, prasaBaM, balAt; apahArabudDyA, atiloBena.
Ⓝ[Rapacious]ness, Rapacity,Ⓒs.ⒹsAha-sikatA, AtatAyitvaM, apahAraSIlatA, apa-haraRabudDi f.
Ⓑ
 2 lubDatA, atiloBaH.

Rape,Ⓒs.Ⓓapa-, haraRaM.
Ⓑ
 2 dUzaRaM, balAtkAreRa-balAt-rataM-saMBogah; haWasaMBogaH, ADarzaH-rzaRaM, balAtkAraH, strIsaMgrahaH; ‘to commit r(ape)’ balAtkAreRa ram 1 A or aBigam 1 P or saMgam 1 A, ADfz c.

Rapid,Ⓒa.ⒹSIGra, druta, kzipra, laGu.
Ⓝ[Rapid]ity, [Rapid]ness,Ⓒs.ⒹtvarA, vegaH, taras n.; drutatA.
Ⓝ[Rapid]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹSIGraM, satvaraM, drutaM; See Quick, [Quick]ly &c.
ⓃRapids,Ⓒs.Ⓓvegavat, srotas n.

Rapt,Ⓒa.Ⓓharzonmatta; paramahfzwa, atyAnaMdita; (for ‘wrapt’) para, lIna, nimagna in comp.
ⓃRapture,Ⓒs.ⒹharzonmAdaH, AnaM-dAtirekaH, harzAveSaH, atyaMtaharzaH, praharzaH, u-nmAdaH.
Ⓝ[Raptur]ed,Ⓒa.Ⓓharzonmatta, unmatta.
Ⓝ[Raptur]ous,Ⓒa.Ⓓunmatta, paramaharzada, mohana; ‘r(apturous) joy’ para-mAnaMdaH.
Ⓝ[Raptur]ously,Ⓒadv.ⒹsonmAdaM, paramaharzeRa; See Ecstasy.
